items.title: Chuck Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 7, 2023
items.q: I also do this music with my wife Ria Curley... Ria and I got married on 10/10/21.

ctx.x: One part of doing what you do I believe is juggling commitments. Do you have — you have the Caffe Lena thing going and some lessons. Who takes precedence in your — is it the Brubecks that — they get on the calendar first?

Yeah. Yeah. But you know we get the itinerary for the year, are there any conflicts for you guys, because I also do this music with my wife Ria Curley, which is really exciting. © Fillius Jazz Archive -13-

So that and the Caffe Lena gig are my other investments in and love playing. But you know so on the itinerary I just say no I can’t do — or it won’t be formalized, they’ll say does anybody have any conflicts, and they just book around it.
